lines.t: God, thus every dry branch must be broken off and cast into the fire.
All corrupt fruit must be left to tread down, for the temple of God has lost its form.
Its comingness has departed, every chamber is empty, for the heart of man is void.
His countenance unyielding, thus the pride of man has become a chasm both deep and wide.
Therefore repent and receive of me
As I am and not as you would have me be
That you may be truly born again
For I am the perfect reflection of the Father
The image of the visible God
I died, behold I am risen
And by my life are you saved
That you might become the perfect reflection of me
The one, O Lord, in whom is everlasting life
